about: ABC powder extinguishers use mono-ammonium phosphate powder and are rated for Class A (solids), B (flammable liquids) and C (gas) fires. They are the most versatile choice for offices, shops, vehicles and workshops.
The powder leaves a residue that can damage electronics, so avoid it in server rooms and food preparation areas. Extinguishers need periodic inspection and refilling after any use.
